votes.evidence: GREEK_NOTATION = /^[A-Z]+[α-ω][A-Zα-ω]*$/u requires Latin capitals before the Greek letter. Ran mixedScript from the bc7090d build: κB true, αSMA true, γH true, αKG true, αvβ true; TNFα, IκBα and NFκB false. INJ-002 tokenizes on \p{L}+, so the hyphenated 'NF-κB' yields 'κB', which is flagged as a warning.
